our anytime anyspace search scheme can be viewed as an extension to the AND/OR search framework for the weighted CSP (W-CSP) task, which is equivalent to the partition function problem.
The main takeaway from our work is that

AND/OR best first tree search can be used to improve bounds in a smooth, anytime way, and that AND/OR search can be used for approximate summation queries in addition to exact summation and optimization.
AND/OR search can be a useful tool for approximate summation, especially when the problem has a large search space, and when the search space has a rich structure that can be exploited.
AND/OR search can be an effective anytime anyspace scheme for improving deterministic bounds on the summation task.
